target_customer: Pharma and biotech teams doing protein characterization (mass spec and related analytics)
problem: Analyzing protein characterization data takes months of manual work as AI generates more drug candidates.
business_model: B2B SaaS / AI analysis platform for enterprise pharma
product_category: AI for proteomics and protein characterization

founders.name: David Roberts
education: BS chemistry and mathematics, UC San Diego (2016)
founders.background_notes: Postdoc and Damon Runyon fellow in Carolyn Bertozzi's Stanford lab.

founders.name: Vishnu Tejus
previous_startups: Earlier YC company (described as 2x YC founder; not named)

technical_complexity.rationale: Requires domain-specific models over mass-spec data and scientific validation; the founders come from a top proteomics lab.

defensibility.rationale: Domain expertise and enterprise pharma integration; no evidence of data or contract lock-in yet.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Too recent to judge; no incumbent action found.

market_need_then: The company says it has enterprise pharma customers onboarding and claims large time savings; TechCrunch (Apr 2026) frames AI producing more drug candidates than can be characterized. Company claims, not independently verified.

brand_strength.rationale: Too early; no brand-focused sources. Name echoes '10x' startup shorthand and 10x Genomics, which may cause some confusion but no source says so.

outcome_analysis: 10x Science, founded in 2025 out of a Stanford lab and in YC W26, raised a $4.8M seed led by Initialized Capital in April 2026 and is Active. It is only months old at the time of research, so no outcome exists; founder domain fit and an early pharma pipeline are the sourced strengths and are not yet proof of product-market fit.
notes: Seed confirmed by a press release carried by two outlets (Pulse 2.0, VCA). Coverage marked partial because the company is new. TechCrunch article fetch returned 404, so competitors not sourced. Some outlets spell 'Tejas' and place the company in Charlottesville; YC and the press release say San Francisco.
